en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīyānuloma (4). Tikadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (4). 22.1.
Kusala-ttika, Hetu-duka.
Homage to that Blessed One, the Worthy One, the Perfectly Self-Awakened One.

Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor a root, a state that is unwholesome and a root arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor a root, a state that is indeterminate and a root arises by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor a root, a state that is wholesome and a root arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor a root, a state that is indeterminate and a root arises by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither-undefined-nor-root, a wholesome state that is a root arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on a state that is neither-undefined-nor-root, an unwholesome state that is a root arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-wholesome-nor-root and a state that is neither-undefined-nor-root, an unwholesome state that is a root arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-root and a state that is neither-undefined-nor-root, a wholesome state that is a root...

A state arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor a root, and neither unwholesome nor a root, a neutral state that is a root arises by way of root condition... three. (Abbreviated.
Nine in the case of root; ... pe ... three in the case of result; ... pe ... nine in the case of non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor root-cause, a state that is unwholesome and not a root-cause arises by way of root-cause condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor root-cause, a state that is indeterminate and not a root-cause arises by way of root-cause condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor root-cause, states that are both unwholesome and not root-causes and indeterminate and not root-causes arise by way of root-cause condition. … Three.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor rootless, a wholesome state that is not a root arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor rootless, an indeterminate state that is not a root arises by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor rootless, both a wholesome state that is not a root and an indeterminate state that is not a root arise by way of root-condition. ... [Three] ... (The remaining combinations follow in the same manner) ... [Three]
Dependent on a state that is neither-defined nor-root-cause, a neither-defined nor-root-cause state arises by way of root-condition … five.
Dependent on a state that is neither-wholesome nor-root-cause and a state that is neither-defined nor-root-cause, a unwholesome nor-root-cause state arises by way of root-condition … three.
Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome nor-root-cause and a state that is neither-defined nor-root-cause, a wholesome nor-root-cause state arises by way of root-condition … three.

Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor root-cause and a state that is neither unwholesome nor root-cause, a neutral non-root-cause state arises by way of root-condition … one. (Abbreviated.
Under root-condition there are eighteen; under object-condition nine … pe … under result-condition three … pe … under non-disappearance-condition eighteen.
